objective: Realize all boundary profiles on one positive joined-diamond formula schedule and prove tight-order bounds for the deterministic memory required by a stage-ordered reader with public wiring; compare grouping by variable.
status: Proved: A single fixed positive-join schedule realizes the full count of residual functions at a protected cut. Exact deterministic one-pass memory is of quadratic order in the maximum number of exposed names, while full indexed reachability takes linear work.
title: Worst-case one-pass memory on a fixed joined two-route formula
